hero.title: Build, manage and play your MESBG army lists.
hero.description: A fast list builder for Middle-earth Strategy Battle Game players, with roster validation, printable cards, digital trackers, match history and collection tools.

new-player.title: Everything you need before, during and after a game
new-player.description: Sign in to create your first roster, manage your collection and keep everything stored safely with your account.

account.title: Create your account
account.description: Keep your rosters, match history, ongoing games and collection stored safely in one place.

build.title: Build your first roster
build.description: Choose an army, add warbands and check points, bows, warriors and validation warnings as you build.

data.title: Bring your hobby data together
data.description: Track games, manage your collection and build a history around the armies you play most.

returning-player.title: Pick up where you left off
returning-player.description: Jump back into your latest rosters, continue an active game, or record your most recent result.

games.title: Resume ongoing game
games.description: Continue tracking Might, Will, Fate, wounds and casualties.

results.title: Add match result
results.description: Log your latest game and keep your match history complete.
